identity.description: Multi-hop structured literature review: retrieves across the whole corpus AND drills into the top-2 topic clusters, then writes a four-section review (OVERVIEW, METHOD COMPARISON, KEY FINDINGS, GAPS) with [n] citations to the source papers. Optional focus input sharpens the comparison axes. Returns a structured review.json artifact with the cited paper list.

inputs.description: A research question about the brain-technology corpus (citations returned as [n])
inputs.example: What are the best EEG motor-imagery decoding methods?

inputs.description: Optional focus to sharpen the review (e.g. "compare Riemannian vs deep-learning decoders" or a specific comparison axis)

outputs.description: The agent’s answer, citing corpus papers as [n]
Cited papers as structured JSON (title, year, arXiv URL)
Structured review as JSON: question, focus, cited papers, and parsed sections (title + body per section)

_default.description: Answer text streamed token-by-token as it is generated
